In the summer of 1975, I was 14 years old. My uncle got me a summer job doing maintenance for the city parks. Cleaning, mowing, painting, that kinda thing. I was saving up to buy a 15 speed Schwinn bicycle.

Worked the whole summer, saved every dime. Payday was Friday. The Saturday after I got my last paycheck, I went down to the bank (they were open a half-day on Saturdays) to withdraw my money and buy my bike. You can probably guess by now what had happened.

Mom had gone down to the bank Friday afternoon and cleaned me out. Closed the account. When I got home and asked her about it (I was still kinda hoping that she might have gone down to the bike shop and got the bike for me, it was no secret which one I wanted) she started screaming at me about going behind her back and checking up on her, who did I think I was, groceries were expensive (we didn't always have money for bread and milk, but somehow there was always money for beer and cigarettes).
